decisions.referenceFirst: Local kit-card projects have no STL assets. Parsed local clicker and fabric STL candidates, rejected switch/link interfaces for sheet assembly; downloaded CC BY4.0 White Cat source before selecting geometry. Read source README/LICENSE and inspected actual mesh sections.
decisions.sheet: Measured0–1.60 mm main sheet -> default1.60 mm, supported1.6–2.4 mm.
decisions.interfaces: Measured4.50×1.700012 mm sockets -> preserve4.50 mm socket length; width=sheet+totalAllowance; tongueWidth=4.50-totalAllowance. Proposed allowance .10–.30 mm TOTAL, printer/material calibration required.
decisions.carrier: Measured low source web planes .21–.22mm -> original three-row connected carrier,24 accessible bed-aligned .4–.6mm tabs .8–1.4mm wide; no original mesh redistributed.
decisions.newMechanism: Original six-part Ames-window kit, asymmetric trapezoid four-pane window with integral4.50×sheet axles. Bearing radius=hypot(2.25,sheet/2)+radialClearance(.20–.45mm),64-sided bore inscribed radius included in validation. Lower floor .8mm; upper bonded keeper with .30mm endplay and≥.50mm remaining lower engagement.
decisions.retention: Keeper and four pillar seats require adhesive; keeper itself checked clear of lintel when rotating and blocks withdrawal only while bonded to axle. No untested friction-seat capture claim.
decisions.variations: Window span52–68mm, tall edge32–42mm, short-edge ratio50–75%, band2.4–3.6mm. These change actual geometry, not just colouring.
decisions.imports: Exact validated convex STL subtracts from base signature patch; PNG/JPEG/simple SVG sampled20×20 heightfield subtraction; bright holes remain uncut backing. Safe6.5mm radius,≥1mm backing, no intrusions into bearings/sockets. Unsupported concavity rejected, no convex-hull substitution.
decisions.difference: Not a spacecraft, static window ornament or prior rotating semaphore flag reskin: a supported full-turn trapezoid window with paired journals and adhesive-bonded axial keeper, with perspective ratio and pane geometry as active design parameters. No optical-performance guarantee.
decisions.verification: Independent STL checks and computational assembly/rotation checks only; no physical printing, adhesive strength, friction, tipping or illusion tests.
